text:
jordan: FYI seeing a perf regression on the INT4 path for long sequences in prod (h100). p95 token latency jumped ~35% after the last autotune roll.

tay: ugh. repro steps?

jordan: load test with 4k seqs, KV cache growth > ~1.2M keys. baseline (before) p50=18ms/token p95=48ms/token. now p50=20ms/token p95=65ms/token. tokens/sec down ~20%.

keiko: is it specific to INT4 kernels or also INT8/FP8?

jordan: looks INT4-only. INT8/FP8 unaffected. The autotuner picked the int4-sm92 kernel variant for latency but it has a different memory access pattern when KV cache > ~1M entries. We see more L2 thrash.

frank: any regression in accuracy or just perf?

jordan: accuracy so far unchanged on short prompts. On long prompts we observed a few mismatched tokens in rare paths — likely numerical noise compounded by cache eviction timing. Need to be careful.

ml-bot: NOTE: rolling back to int4-sm86 restored perf to expected range in canary. No correctness deltas in evals (diff < 0.001 perplexity).

tay: timeline? can we bump a hotfix autotune rule now?

keiko: propose adding sequence-length + kv-size gating in autotuner. rule: only pick int4-sm92 when (seq_len <= 2048 AND kv_entries < 1_000_000) else prefer int4-sm86 or fallback to int8-sm92.

jordan: +1. also add a conservative safety margin per-arch: margin_factor = 1.15 for sm92 int4 memory estimate. If predicted working set * margin_factor > L2_limit -> don't pick.

frank: can you paste a sample rule/snippet? easier to review.

jordan: sure:
```json
{
  "arch": "sm92",
  "quant": "int4",
  "conditions": {
    "max_seq_len": 2048,
    "max_kv_entries": 1000000,
    "working_set_margin": 1.15
  },
  "fallback_order": ["int4-sm86", "int8-sm92", "fp8-sm92"]
}
```

keiko: looks good. also add telemetry tags so we can correlate kernel picks with p50/p95 and kv size: tag kernel.autotune.choice, kv.size_bucket, seq.bucket, arch.

tay: add unit test: synthesize kv sizes (0.2M/0.6M/1.2M/2M) and seq lens (512/2048/4096) and assert pick==expected. And perf test that measures tokens/sec under 10% of baseline is a fail.

frank: need a guard for rollout: start with canary 5% traffic, monitor error/latency and an automatic rollback if p95 regresses >10% for 10min.

opsbot: deploy plan: create autotune-rule+canary job, set rolling window 10m, alert if p95 delta > 10%. Will also tag flows.

ml-bot: added eval harness run: long-seq smoke with synthetic prompts. Results: int4-sm92 failing 3/100 runs with small token diffs and 18% p95 spike. int4-sm86 stable.

jordan: next steps:
- land gating rule in autotuner (keiko)
- add unit/perf tests to CI (tay)
- apply canary and monitor (ops)
- follow up to see if sm92 int4 kernel can be patched to fix L2 pattern (eng-runtime/low-level) (frank)

keiko: I'll open a PR for the rule and tests today. tagging @frank for kernel investigation.

frank: will repro locally with perf counters (L2 miss ratio, dram BW) and share flame graphs. likely kernel-level stride issue.

tay: thanks. once PR is up I'll wire the CI checks.

jordan: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
